snippet.title: 🐔🛸 Chickenauts | Coming Soon to Early Access (Steam)
snippet.description:
The fowl smell lingers in the air… Hold on to your hats, folks! It must be those mutant-robo-chickens! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350460/Chickenauts/

They’re… back!? Or rather, they're finally coming in full (almost) swing! We’re proud to announce that Chickenauts will be coming to Early Access quite soon! 🚀🐣

🍗🍗🍗 Wishlist & Follow the game, so you won't miss delicious stuff that's cooking! 🍗🍗🍗
